snippet.title: Blow Up: Avenge Humanity - Accessibility Trailer - Access-Ability Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: BLOW-UP: AVENGE HUMANITY is a single-player fast paced first person shooter campaign where you take control of an industrial robot rewired by the last human being to violently dispatch the alien race accountable for Earth’s destruction. Are you ready to become the ultimate avenger?
